title: Honeypot Prompt Injection: Testing Whether Deployed Agents Resist Planted Malicious Instructions
original_idea: Develop framework for inserting honeypot prompt injections into agent-accessible environments. Test agents on controlled tasks with various injection styles. Measure detection rates and false positive rates for heuristic vs. prompt-based monitors.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Methodology and benchmark for testing agent injection defenses. Directly practical for the agentic safety community.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires building an agent pipeline, designing injection types, implementing two monitor types. Moderate complexity but all components use standard tools.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Framework design, injection type taxonomy, two monitors, multiple agent tasks. Ambitious scope for 30hrs despite practical framing.
